# Copilot Instructions

Before reviewing a pull request in this repository, read `docs/ai-review.md` — it documents
team conventions (build/generated files are committed at release, `@since TBD` placeholders,
release pipeline, color system ownership, deprecation policy). Do not flag as issues things
that doc describes as intentional process.

For the build layout, see `docs/build-process.md` and `docs/project-structure.md`.
